text: Acceptance 7/GC3: posting trusts a client-supplied sessionId without checking its owner. In-memory test: Alice's session is typing; Bob calls postMessage with sessionId='alice-session' => before=true, after=false, messageActor=2, messageSession='alice-session'. Session IDs are exposed by presence. Validate ownership before persisting session attribution or clearing typing, including all callers of postMessage.
